settings.title: Heavyweight cotton
settings.text: Dense combed cotton, pre-shrunk and garment-dyed so your tees and long sleeves keep their size, shape and colour wash after wash.
settings.focus_text: A tight knit that keeps tees from twisting or shrinking, dyed after sewing for a soft, lived-in colour.

settings.title: Brushed fleece
settings.text: Heavyweight 12–14oz cotton fleece, brushed on the inside for warmth. Used in our quarter-zips, hoodies, sweatshirts and sweatpants.
settings.focus_text: Thick cotton fleece brushed on the inside for warmth, with a smooth face that resists pilling.

settings.title: Sculpt knit
settings.text: A smooth four-way-stretch knit that holds you in and never goes see-through. Used in our flare leggings, biker shorts and sports bras.
settings.focus_text: A smooth, buttery knit that holds you in, wicks sweat and never goes see-through.
